method: Read all 371 driver lines, 89 test lines and 175 template lines, plus the original reader, writer and writer-lock implementations.
Rehashed all eight unchanged original source/control bindings at exact 8f.

Independently fetched both published source files, both Git commit metadata records and the bound workflow; source bytes match the manifest and the published source delta contains only the two added test files.
Reversing the three declared source SHA/tree/branch substitutions restores the exact template bytes.
findings: The manager route pauses the original bounded reader at os.read after its existing descriptor and metadata checks. The Codex route pauses the actual Path.read_text read through its owned Path.open handle.
All other original read/open/close calls are forwarded. Scoped patches restore through ExitStack, and each declared case has a fresh temporary fixture.
The writer uses the original writer lock and private atomic replacement exactly once. Released-reader controls are separate fresh cases, not retries of failed writes.
The report preserves the original replacement exception by identity in the fixture and exports only closed error kinds and integer codes, fixed value classes and cleanup flags.
The workflow binds pinned source/imports before and after, runs one six-case child, retains partial reports and original failure exit, and does not run a performance workload.
The strict held-reader expectation requires original PermissionError WinError 32; another code remains a failed control and is not silently accepted.
The prepublication manifest's statement that publication/execution had not occurred is historical; this peer separately binds the subsequently published source and driver.
